address: Scarlet Hotel, Tredragon Road, Mawgan Porth, Cornwall,TR8 4DQ
bio: Enjoy an Afternoon Tea experience like no other in the peaceful surroundings of Scarlet Hotel.  Nestled on the north coast of Cornwall, Scarlet Hotel is a tranquil eco hideaway with a breath-taking backdrop of sea and cliff tops. Afternoon Tea is served in the bright and airy Scarlet Restaurant, gazing out over Mawgan Porth beach to the Atlantic ocean beyond.  Their Afternoon Tea menu comprises a selection of mouth-watering sandwiches on artisan bread, warm scones with Cornish clotted cream and strawberry jam, along with a delectable sweet plate, featuring an array of homemade cakes and pastries. All of this is served alongside a warming pot of tea from the local Tregothnan estate.  Scarlet Hotel sits just 5 miles from Newquay town, within easy reach of Fistral Beach and a short drive from the town of Padstow.
